newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Large-cap firms lift Moroccan bourse 0.81 pct.
newsitem.headline: Large-cap firms lift Moroccan bourse 0.81 pct.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed 0.81 percent higher on Thursday lifted by the market's large-capitalisation firms, including Societe Nationale d'Investissement, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 490.35 points from 486.39 points on Wednesday.
"The bourse two-hour trading was calm...The all-share index continues its rising trend due to usual lack of liquidity," a trader said.
SNI, Morocco's second largest private conglomerate and which holds stakes in more than 40 firms, rose four dirhams to close at 564 dirhams.
Sugar firm Cosumar, a subsidiary of ONA Group, was the day's best performer jumping 41 dirhams to 848 dirhams.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private group which has a market capitalisation of more than 10.6 billion dirhams, remained unchanged at 625 dirhams.
Blue chip, Wafabank gained 19 dirhams to trade at 644 dirhams.
Consumer credit firm Credor which was floated on the bourse in December, pursued its upward trend to close at 673 dirhams, up 19 dirhams over the previous session.
Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique was up five dirhams to 173 dirhams. The government said it would soon sell 34.57 percent of its stake in the bank. The tender will close on Friday.
Traded volume on the official market was 44.9 million dirhams from 65.4 million on Wednesday.
